# möbius 0.9.9

- Moves model metadata, replay projection, and session-file policy into frontend-neutral protocol records.
- Makes cron command grammar and presentation capability-owned.
- Validates tool definitions and submitted attachment bounds before execution.
- Simplifies extension package processing and keeps sandbox enforcement at its backend boundary.

Gateway protocol 47, configuration 20, and chat specification 9 are supported by the companion Gateway release.
